q1.sampleAnswer: Because the government wanted to keep kids safe online.

keyPoints.descZh: 让孩子们在网上更安全
examples: Because the government wanted to keep kids safe online.

q1.rubricZh: 要点：让孩子们在网上更安全。
q1.explanationZh: 第一段说，新规的目标是让孩子在网上更安全。

evidence.quote: The goal was to keep kids safe online.

q2.sampleAnswer: Many of them could still use their social media accounts and log in.

keyPoints.descZh: 许多孩子仍然能使用社交媒体账号并登录
examples: Many of them could still use their social media accounts and log in.

q2.rubricZh: 要点：许多孩子仍然能使用社交媒体账号并登录。
q2.explanationZh: 第二段说研究发现，很多孩子还能用账号登录，约有 61% 的孩子能登录。

evidence.quote: Many of them said they still can use their social media accounts.

keyPoints.descZh: 回答不是所有人都同意（No）

q3.rubricZh: 要点：回答不是所有人都同意（No）。
q3.explanationZh: 第三段说有些孩子觉得这条规定作用很小，所以并不是所有人都同意。

q4.sampleAnswer: China has limited the time teenagers can play online games.

keyPoints.descZh: 中国限制了青少年玩网络游戏的时间
examples: China has limited the time teenagers can play online games.
Children under 18 can only play online games for a short time on weekends and holidays.

q4.rubricZh: 要点：中国限制了青少年玩网络游戏的时间。
q4.explanationZh: 第四段说中国规定18岁以下的孩子只能在周末和假期玩很短时间的网络游戏。

evidence.quote: children under 18 can usually play online games only for a short time on weekends and holidays

q5.sampleAnswer: They show that many countries are trying to protect young people online.

keyPoints.descZh: 许多国家都在努力保护青少年的网络安全
examples: They show that many countries are trying to protect young people online.

q5.rubricZh: 要点：许多国家都在努力保护青少年的网络安全。
q5.explanationZh: 两国的规定都是想保护孩子，别的国家也在关注，说明很多国家都想让孩子上网更安全。

evidence.quote: Other countries are now watching Australia’s social media ban closely.
